mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.product_id, o.amount, o.status, o.remark, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.created_at, o.paid_at, o.finished_at, oi.product_title, oi.product_cover, bu.nickname AS buyer_nickname, su.nickname AS seller_nickname
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, status, remark, created_at, paid_at, finished_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN users bu ON bu.id = o.buyer_id JOIN users su ON su.id = o.seller_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAY'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND status = 'PAID'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAY' AND (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId})
